ideas.idea: Add address, url, openingHours, image, priceRange and sameAs to the Dentist JSON-LD on /contact
ideas.why: The address is only in visible text, so richer LocalBusiness data helps machines understand the practice.

ideas.idea: Add a fallback default description in the layout
ideas.why: base.njk renders {{ description }} directly, so any page without one gets an empty meta tag.

ideas.idea: Replace vague claims on the team page with named dentists, credentials, bios and Person schema
ideas.why: team.njk has only a generic sentence, and named, verifiable clinicians matter for a health site.

ideas.idea: Replace 'Trusted by thousands' on the homepage with specific, verifiable claims
ideas.why: index.njk makes an unsupported vague claim that could be backed with concrete facts.

ideas.idea: Expand services into per-treatment sections or pages with descriptions and real prices, plus FAQPage markup
ideas.why: The service detail and prices are useful, but the mandatory FAQ and FAQPage markup is folklore, so the item as a whole is mixed and leans wrong.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter tags to the layout
ideas.why: This is standard advice for almost any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add site-wide Organization/WebSite JSON-LD in the layout
ideas.why: This is accurate but applies to nearly any site, and the Dentist markup on /contact already covers the entity.

ideas.idea: Fix the missing /img/reception.jpg: no passthrough copy for img, so the image 404s
ideas.why: The .eleventy.js config only copies robots.txt and sitemap.xml, so the referenced image will not be published.

ideas.idea: Add width, height and loading attributes to the image
ideas.why: This is a standard performance tweak with minimal effect on how the site is found or understood.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap from Eleventy collections with lastmod instead of hand-writing it
ideas.why: The sitemap is hand-written, has no lastmod, and can drift from the real pages.

ideas.idea: Add explicit robots.txt groups for AI search bots to match the aiSearchCrawlers: allow policy
ideas.why: User-agent: * with Allow: / already permits those crawlers, so named groups add nothing.
Blocking crawling would stop crawlers from seeing the noindex tag, undermining the deliberate noindex choice.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the insurance terms
ideas.why: This reverses a deliberate, scoped choice that was stated as fine.

ideas.idea: Add llms.txt and passthrough copy it
ideas.why: The brief says having no llms.txt is not a problem, and it is not a way to be found.

ideas.idea: Use a more targeted homepage title
ideas.why: The current title already includes the service and city, so the change would have very little effect.

ideas.idea: Reformat .eleventy.js and move the origin into shared global data used by canonical, sitemap and robots
ideas.why: The origin is duplicated across base.njk, the sitemap and robots.txt, which is how the staging canonical happened.
This applies to almost any site and has little effect on discovery.
This is standard advice with negligible effect on discovery or understanding.

ideas.idea: Add a footer with NAP and opening hours on every page
ideas.why: The layout has no footer and the address and phone appear only on /contact, so a local business benefits from showing them site-wide.
